description: This file contains Ukrainian localization (i18n) strings for the Select2 jQuery plugin version 4.0.6-rc.1.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the message when results cannot be loaded.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns the message when the user has input too many characters, suggesting removal.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns the message when the user has input too few characters, prompting to input more.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns the loading message when more results are being fetched.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns the message indicating the maximum number of items that can be selected.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns the message when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns the message displayed while searching.
